title.narrative: Multi Donor Trust Fund for the Debt Management Facility for LowIncome Countries

description.narrative: The GPP's primary development objective is to strengthen debt management capacity and institutions in developing countries through: (i) systematic and regular assessment of capacity across a comprehensive range of debt management performance indicators, (ii) the development of debt management reform programs building on assessment results, (iii) country-led application of the toolkit for medium-term debt management strategies (MTDS), (iv) enhanced coordination among the international providers of debt management technical assistance, and (v) promotion of learning and knowledge generation via an extensive program of training & outreach.

Netherlands - Ministry for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation
